product.officialTitle: Adult's Ski Helmet Freeride FR 900 Mips Black & White

sizeEvidence.matchingEvidence: Both official regional pages identify product ID 8773682 and the same black/white H-FR 900 MIPS product.
sizeEvidence.limitation: The size range is confirmed across regions; regional stock, price and delivery availability are not interchangeable.

sizes.source: Decathlon Belgium official same-product page; availability is region-specific and not inferred for the UK.

specifications.mips: Official page says the low-friction layer allows 10-15 mm multi-directional movement under certain oblique impacts to reduce rotational force transferred to the head and brain.
specifications.recco: Integrated RECCO reflector; compatible resort rescue teams need a RECCO detector. It is not an avalanche transceiver.
specifications.ventilation: Adjustable two-mode system: passive ventilation at rest and channeled airflow while skiing.
specifications.fit: Adjustment wheel, adjustable height, 3D ears, adjustable chin strap; choose usual size and check goggle fit.
specifications.other: No visor; compatible with glasses and goggles; no fixed or removable chin guard.
specifications.safety: Replace after impact. Decathlon recommends changing at least every five years; significant impact warrants earlier replacement.

officialUsageClassification.interpretation: 商品页分类标签，不是安全等级或使用限制。

specifications.season: Official product page does not state a snow season. The support page lists conformity-document downloads from 2021 to 2024 for the FR 900 MIPS family, which does not establish the exact product season.
